items.raw_excerpt: More than 3.8 million people were members of public libraries in the Netherlands in 2025, a 3% increase over the year before according to new numbers by national statistics office CBS. In total, 9% of adults are library members. That statistic is dwarfed by the number of children who...

items.raw_excerpt: Do you know that feeling when your alarm clock goes off early in the morning and it feels physically painful to get out of bed? The Danes have coined a term for that and we've made it our expression of the day.

items.raw_excerpt: If you plan to move to or stay in Italy long-term, then learning Italian should definitely be at the top of your to-do list. But when's the best time to start learning?
